messages.snippet: Henry, Helena, Great news – the MSSA executed today. Counterparts exchanged by email with Harcourt;
messages.subject: Meridian / Harcourt MSSA – EXECUTED
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Helena,

Great news – the MSSA executed today. Counterparts exchanged by email with Harcourt; wet-ink originals to follow by post. Final executed version attached for your records.

Key agreed terms as signed:
- Annual subscription £840,000; implementation £120,000.
- 3-year initial term; Service Commencement Date 5 Jan 2026.
- Payment 45 days; RPI uplift capped 4% from year 2.
- General liability cap 150% of trailing fees; data-protection super-cap £2,520,000 (300% of annual fee).

Congratulations on the deal. We'll send our final invoice shortly.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
